instruction: Replace the VS Code logo in the welcome screen with the image file from Downloads.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not allow customization of the welcome screen logo. The logo is hard-coded into the application and cannot be changed through settings, extensions, or user configurations.
